title: Normalizer laws for the frozen mlk_barrett_reduce implementation

properties.name: centered fixed point
properties.claim: For every int16_t a in [-1664,1664], mlk_barrett_reduce(a) equals a.

properties.name: idempotence
properties.claim: For every int16_t a, reducing the result again does not change it.

properties.name: residue-class invariance
properties.claim: For every int16_t pair a,b congruent modulo 3329, their reduced results are equal.

conditional_domain_policy: Antecedents are encoded as implications, not assumptions.
control_policy: A separate concrete witness harness confirms representative fixed-point, idempotence, and same-residue paths.
mathematical_classification: Derived normalizer laws, not new modular-arithmetic theorems.
portability_scope: Signed right shift follows the semantics represented by the recorded CBMC environment.
